name: 1-nichi Dake no Tenkousei
source:
"Even though it's only for a day, please teach me."
True to her words, the transfer student attended school for one day before disappearing.
As it turned out, the reason for her absence was truly sad.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/693]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
“虽然只有一天，但请教我。”
正如她所说，转校生在学校上学了一天后就消失了。
事实证明，她缺席的原因确实令人悲伤。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/693]NovelGame[/url]]
